build_note: Source-built from the pinned sdist on Debian 12 (Python 3.11, clang 14): setup.py's generate step runs libpg_query's own make clean/all with DEBUG=1 (-O0) under LLVM source coverage (bison/flex #line directives removed first), then Cython 3.0.10 compiles the wrapper src/pg_query/__init__.py into src/pg_query/__init__.c, which clang compiles with LLVM coverage and links against libpg_query.a. The official wheels compile the same sources.
dependencies_note: protobuf 5.29.5 (runtime: decodes the libpg_query protobuf bytes into psqlparse2.pb.pg_query_pb2 messages); Cython, setuptools, wheel, setuptools-scm and packaging are build-only. The fuzz entry point is an external one-file Python bridge, not Atheris.
parser_family: PostgreSQL grammar (libpg_query extraction of the PostgreSQL server parser), shared with the C libpg_query path, Python pglast and Rust pg_query; psqlparse2 vendors its own libpg_query 16-5.1.0 (PostgreSQL 16.1 grammar) behind a Cython wrapper and generated Python protobuf types
api: psqlparse2.query_to_pb(local SQL text decoded from UTF-8 bytes) -> psqlparse2.pb.pg_query_pb2.ParseResult; the harness walks the protobuf RawStmt list and SelectStmt, InsertStmt, RangeVar, JoinExpr, FuncCall and A_Const messages
fuzz_engine: external one-file Python bridge for AFL++ and generator replay
coverage: LLVM source-region coverage (macro expansions skipped) of the source-built psqlparse2 extension: the Cython-generated wrapper src/pg_query/__init__.c and the statically linked libpg_query 16-5.1.0 sources; the AFL++ bridge maps regions and branches of the wrapper and the libpg_query grammar, scanner, raw_parser and protobuf output files
scope: One SQL statement from local text via psqlparse2.query_to_pb (PostgreSQL 16 grammar); valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls only, each matching the hand-written oracle summary. Deparse, normalize, JSON parse and the optimised wheel build are untested.
underlying_release: libpg_query 16-5.1.0 (vendored in the psqlparse2 sdist; PostgreSQL 16.1 raw parser, scanner and protobuf output)
